provenance.recipe: Unmodified original ONNX Mul -> Add/Sub with dynamic raw float32 inputs; all declared outputs scheduled jointly once, final outputs only. Held product, held Identity and shared-product controls are distinct contexts.
provenance.scope: CPU direct f32 runtime-buffer Mul+Add with non-growing source movements and distinct roots; ordinary finite initializer constants, supported pinned Conv scale/quantized residual and source-direct IMAGE epilogue profiles. Computed producers/addends, joint held/shared/moved aliases, runtime broadcast reuse and symbolic-special constants remain explicit original-valid unsupported cases.
